subject: general
question: In 2025, which Indian regulatory body launched the 'Digital India Financial Literacy Mission' to enhance awareness about digital finance and online fraud prevention?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

solution: The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** launched the '**Digital India Financial Literacy Mission**' in **2025** to enhance public awareness about **digital finance, online fraud prevention**, and safe financial practices. • This initiative aligns with the broader **Digital India campaign**, which aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. • The mission focuses on educating citizens about safe digital transactions, including the use of **UPI, online banking, mobile wallets**, and other digital payment platforms. • The RBI's proactive measures under this mission aim to combat the rising instances of **cyber frauds** and promote secure financial behavior among individuals. • The program is rolled out nationwide, targeting rural and urban populations, emphasizing the need for financial inclusion and literacy in the digital era.
